versions.name: Camp Reeves
versions.summary: A rustic, primitive camp within the Occoneechee Council's scout reservation near Carthage, North Carolina, just beyond Camp Durant, offering simple campsites, a waterfront, and a quiet wooded setting for back-to-basics unit camping.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Occoneechee Council camp page at ocscouts.org. The source labeled this a Tuscarora Council camp; it is an Occoneechee Council property within the Occoneechee Scout Reservation. Coordinates geocoded via US Census (reservation entrance); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and active status verified against the council's own camp page; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a primitive short-term camping property; features unsurveyed.
